candidates.change_summary: Change the function to return false instead of true at the end, making return value differ while execution still completes.
Change the final return to return the success of the last external call by capturing and returning the call's boolean result instead of always true.
Insert an early unconditional return(true) inside the loop after the first call so function returns true immediately (may change return for some inputs).
Replace the loop with a single call to the first recipient only, changing return behavior due to single call but still returning true.
Change the low-level call to use call{value: v} so value sent to caddress differs and may change external-observable behavior of transfer calls.
Change the selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which function is invoked on caddress and thus observable behavior.
Pass the amount 0 to the encoded call instead of v, changing the transferred value argument observed by callee.
Stop iterating after the first recipient by adding a break, so only the first _tos is invoked; changes observable transfers.
Reverse iteration order to iterate from last to first, altering the sequence of calls and their observable effects.
